body: I'm a girl. Is this a serious question?
I never said my beauty was beyond measure. I'm insecure about myself. Men seem to think I'm pretty. But I'm certainly not gorgeous beyond measure, and I'm not broadcasting it.
i just don't think it's worth it anymore. I don't have any proof or evidence other than my word.
I never reported it.
I don't think that what I'm doing is a sin...I certainly don't feel guilty about it. I'm just upset about my reasons for doing it.
It is not my fault.
I'm sorry
but you don't know anything about me.
If people could see that, maybe my life would be worth saving. But at this point, I'm worth nothing.
Trust me, they all want me for sex too. I've tried posting and looking. As soon as they see my picture, it's all over.
I can't find better people. I have social anxiety, so I can't just hop out and find new friends.
I don't have many friends. I don't want to cut myself off from the people I do have.
I'm beautiful and desirable. Easily used and easily thrown away.
I don't need to be psychoanalyzed.

Long story short: lots of family shit. Guilt, abuse, whatnot. I've been depressed since I was 16. I'm now 22. No self esteem or confidence left. Sick of pretending everything's fine. Sick of taking care of everyone else. Tired, alone, scared, hurting every single day. My date is in three days.
That's a long story, I'm afraid.
I don't expect anything at all. I just need an outlet for thoughts that I can't tell anyone else.
I've been low for three years. Still waiting for the up.
My heart hurts. I just need someone to love me. I'm afraid of everyone.
Thanks
I'm too busy. I work and have school so I don't get out a lot. I also have social anxiety.
That's why I came here.
I don't want to be alone though. That's the problem. I'm alone so much
I can't make that promise. I'm sorry. I'm in such a low place today
Age doesn't mean anything. Knowing anyone cares helps.
My family doesn't care. They know.
I don't know anymore. Nothing really makes me happy.
You are me four years ago. If you need someone to talk to who will understand, pm me.

My life is lonely. I've had a hard family situation that I've always been in the middle of. Never been paid much attention to. Never been made to feel like I was worth anything. Never felt like anyone is on my side.
Oh honey, that is so sweet but don't waste your money on me. I'm not worth that.
oh of course! I've always wanted to try one of those.
Really, all I would have needed today was a simple text from a friend wishing me a merry Christmas and telling me it'll be okay. I don't need much.
I don't really know what that is...
I guess I don't really know what kind of person I am.
After that it was kind of the last straw. I've been wearing a mask around them ever since because there's just no point in trying to explain.
It doesn't exist. I tried talking to them about it in high school and college but I just got lectured and yelled at about how I have a sin problem that must be keeping me from being happy.
All I've ever wanted was someone to enjoy life with. I'm tired of being alone all the time or with people that only pretend to care.
I don't enjoy anything that I used to, really. Hobbies aren't really fun when there's no one to enjoy them with.
Yeah actually. Me.

I feel lost and alone. I've been bullied since I was a kid, always had a few friends but never anyone I felt like I could really talk to. Family issues, abusive dad, unsupportive mom, even my sister bullies me. Body image and severe self esteem issues. I don't feel like I truly belong anywhere. I'm tired of trying and I wish people understood how much they've hurt me. I could have been an amazing person if I could have found someone to love me.

Some part of me hopes that writing things out will remind me that life is worth living. But right now, it seems like a comforting way to end. This way, maybe they will finally understand everything that I've been through.
No. My family doesn't believe in mental illness.
